snake.title: Snake Game
snake.description: A snake game with a modern look and classic mechanics. Steer the snake, collect food and avoid crashing into the walls or into your own body.
snake.keywords: snake game, snake online, classic arcade, retro, browser game, PlayfulHub
snake.features: Modern visuals, smooth controls, scoring system, visual effects
snake.objective: Collect food to grow and reach the highest score you can.
controls: Speed the snake up: it costs points while you hold it
tips: Start slowly to get used to the controls
Plan your moves so you don't trap yourself
Use the edges of the screen as part of your strategy
Stay calm when the snake gets long
snake.uiNote: Heads-up: the mode and map menus and the shop are in Portuguese; the in-game messages are in English.

space_shooter.title: Space Shooter
space_shooter.description: Relive the golden age of arcade games with this classic space shooter. Fly through space, destroy enemies and survive waves of alien attacks.
space_shooter.keywords: space shooter, arcade, spaceship, shoot em up, action, classic, browser game, PlayfulHub
space_shooter.features: Multiple weapons, power-ups, scoring system, visual effects
space_shooter.objective: Survive the waves of enemies and reach the highest score you can.
tips: Keep moving at all times to dodge enemy fire
Collect power-ups whenever you can to boost your firepower
Prioritize enemies that move in predictable patterns
Use the edges of the screen as a tactical advantage
space_shooter.uiNote: Heads-up: some labels and messages (stage, special shot, weapons hangar) are in Portuguese.

pinball.title: Pinball
pinball.description: Play classic pinball with realistic physics and multiple objectives. Use the flippers to keep the ball in play and reach the highest score.
pinball.keywords: pinball, pinball online, flippers, physics, arcade, classic, browser game, PlayfulHub
pinball.features: Realistic physics, multiple objectives, scoring system
pinball.objective: Keep the ball in play and reach the highest score you can.
controls: Left / right flippers (A/D and the arrow keys work too)
tips: Timing is everything: learn when to hit the flippers
Use the nudge sparingly
Watch the ball's patterns to predict its movements
Focus on specific objectives to maximize your points
pinball.uiNote: Heads-up: the in-game display is in English, but the controls screen is in Portuguese (the controls are listed below).

3d_shooter.title: 3D Shooter
3d_shooter.description: A first-person shooter in the classic Doom style. Make your way through a maze, shoot enemies and survive as long as you can in this 3D action game.
3d_shooter.keywords: 3D shooter, FPS, Doom-style, maze, action, browser game, PlayfulHub
3d_shooter.features: 3D graphics, multiple weapons, complex maze, health system
3d_shooter.objective: Make your way through the maze, take out enemies and survive as long as possible.
tips: Use sound to locate enemies before you see them
Save your ammo: you don't always need to shoot
Explore the maze to find weapons and useful items
Keep moving so nothing catches you by surprise

voxel_city.title: Voxel City Delivery
voxel_city.description: Explore a vibrant voxel city, pick up packages and deliver them in this open-world 3D game. Drive cars, walk around and complete delivery missions!
voxel_city.keywords: voxel, voxel city, delivery game, 3D, open world, driving, simulation, browser game, PlayfulHub
voxel_city.features: 3D voxel graphics, day/night cycle, drivable vehicles, minimap, delivery missions
voxel_city.objective: Find the green target to pick up the package and deliver it to the red target before time runs out!
tips: Use the minimap in the bottom-right corner to find the pickup (green) and delivery (red) targets
Cars are faster: get close to one and press Space to get in
Keep an eye on the day/night cycle: the city lights help you navigate at night
Complete deliveries quickly to earn more points!
voxel_city.uiNote: Heads-up: most of the game is in English, but a few labels (such as the weather and the police alerts) are in Portuguese.

voxel_arena.title: Voxel Arena
voxel_arena.description: Survive in a vibrant voxel arena in this 3D hack and slash. Face waves of enemies, use special abilities, level up your hero and defeat the final boss.
voxel_arena.keywords: voxel, arena, hack and slash, action, survival, 3D, abilities, boss fight, browser game, PlayfulHub
voxel_arena.features: 3D voxel graphics, enemy waves, 4 special abilities, roguelite upgrades, multi-phase boss
voxel_arena.objective: Survive the enemy waves, level up and defeat the arena's final boss.
tips: Use the Dash to escape when you're surrounded
Save the Ultimate for large groups of enemies
Keep moving so you don't get cornered
Collect the XP orbs to level up and choose upgrades
voxel_arena.uiNote: Heads-up: the menus are in English, but boss names and phases, the power choice and the pause screen are in Portuguese.

gameoflife.title: Conway's Game of Life
gameoflife.description: A cellular automaton simulation where cells live or die by simple rules. Watch complex patterns emerge from simple rules.
gameoflife.keywords: conway, game of life, cellular automaton, simulation, mathematics, patterns, browser game, PlayfulHub
gameoflife.features: Classic Conway rules, emergent patterns, speed controls
gameoflife.objective: Watch how complex patterns emerge from simple rules.
controls: Clear the grid or fill it with random cells
tips: Start with simple patterns and watch what happens
Try different starting setups
Some patterns are "gliders": they travel across the grid
The beauty is in the simplicity of the rules
gameoflife.uiNote: Heads-up: the main controls are in English, but the rules panel and some options are in Portuguese.

rubiks_cube.title: Rubik's Cube
rubiks_cube.description: Solve the classic Rubik's Cube in 3D! Turn the faces, sort the colors and test your problem-solving skills.
rubiks_cube.keywords: rubik's cube, rubiks cube online, 3D puzzle, colors, challenge, browser game, PlayfulHub
rubiks_cube.objective: Arrange the cube's faces so that each one is a single color.
controls: Turn a layer: drag a piece on one face
Rotate the camera around the cube
U D L R F B
Turn the matching face (Shift reverses the direction)
Scramble the cube or solve it automatically
Timer: hold until it turns green, then release
tips: Start by solving one face completely
Learn basic algorithms for specific moves
Practice spatial visualization
Don't give up: the cube is a real challenge!
rubiks_cube.uiNote: Heads-up: the main buttons are in English, but the tutorial, the timer hints and the statistics are in Portuguese.

puzzle.title: Puzzle Master
puzzle.description: Decipher the arcane riddles of the Astral Sanctuary through logic challenges, a 3D prism, memory and celestial constellations, in Portuguese or English.
puzzle.keywords: puzzle, logic puzzle, brain game, memory game, 3D prism, riddles, browser game, PlayfulHub
puzzle.features: Campaign, Endless and Time Attack modes, logic, memory and 3D prism puzzles, interface in Portuguese and English
puzzle.objective: Decipher all the arcane riddles of the legendary library, manage your Mental Focus and attune mystical relics in the Grimoire.
controls: Select runes and rotate the 3D prism
Switch the language in real time
tips: Study the progression of the number sequences (arithmetic, geometric and recursive) to deduce the next number
In the 3D prism, rotate the faces until the Select Rune ★ is in front before clicking Verify
Pay attention to where the revealed runes sit in the memory challenge so you don't lose Mental Focus to mistakes
Open the Grimoire of Relics and equip up to 2 relics to get bonuses such as free hints and extra time
